description: LLM inference of an 8B open-weight model (Apertus 8B class) on a GPU server (docs/model/fleet-simulation.md section 5.2). Work unit = one token, input and output counted alike. Type 1: fixed price, served first.

energy_kwh_per_work_unit.source: 0.21 J per token / 3.6e6 J per kWh = 5.83e-8 kWh: RTX 4090, vLLM batched, 450 W / 2,148 tok/s (data/raw/market/hardware.csv pe-rtx4090-vllm-iog-qps8, opened, medium); conservative reading: every token, input and output, costs 0.21 J (docs/research/profitability-inputs.md, 'Conservative (a floor)')

size.source: Azure LLM inference trace 2024, service conv, input + output tokens per request (data/derived/demand/llm-token-quantiles.csv; data/raw/demand-traces/azure-llm-2024/SOURCE.md, https://github.com/Azure/AzurePublicDataset/blob/master/AzureLLMInferenceDataset2024.md, CC BY 4.0, retrieved 2026-11-21). Input and output quantiles are summed at the same quantile (comonotonic approximation); piecewise-linear inverse CDF, capped at the 0.99 quantile (7,387 tokens); min 1 token at q = 0: TODO(source) minimum request size not in the trace. The sampled mean (1,769.5) is the basis for the volume; the file's mean row is 1,738.4 (1,632.8 in + 105.6 out)

batch_size.source: scenario value, not sourced: 1,000 requests per job keeps the job count manageable (about 1,600 jobs/day instead of 1.6 million)

max_chunks.source: scenario value, not sourced: a 1,000-request job may be split over up to 8 servers

min_chunk_work_units.source: derived: mean tokens per request of the size distribution (one request is the split granularity, docs/model/fleet-simulation.md section 5.2); checked against the size distribution mean by the test suite

start_overhead_s.source: TODO(source): model-load time per chunk start not sourced; 0 = not modelled

min_load.source: TODO(source): lowest sustainable GPU load not sourced; 0 = continuous load as Core (HeatBalance reference)

lifecycle.source: allow_pause: interruptible = true in config/jobs/llm-summary-apertus-8b.json; checkpointable: scenario value, completed requests are kept on stop; not measured

input_mb_per_work_unit.source: TODO(source): prompt data size not in the repo; 0 = not modelled (not used by the engine)

state_mb.source: TODO(source): checkpoint size not in the repo; 0 = not modelled (not used by the engine)

placement_policy.source: scenario value: generic API traffic without a customer contract; a real customer must carry its own policy (docs/decisions/0013-job-data-locality.md)

tokens_per_week.source: cd-t1-openrouter-week (data/raw/market/compute-demand.csv): OpenRouter 194 trillion tokens in the week ending 2026-10-26, via press https://fourweekmba.com/ai-openrouters-run-rate-tops-10-quadrillion-tokens-up-6-7x/, low: search snippet, page not opened, read from a chart label

volume_scale.source: scenario value: reference volume, no scaling

arrival_shape.source: Azure LLM inference trace 2024, service conv (data/raw/demand-traces/azure-llm-2024/SOURCE.md, https://github.com/Azure/AzurePublicDataset/blob/master/AzureLLMInferenceDataset2024.md, CC BY 4.0, retrieved 2026-11-21); the trace's US-dominated user base is a caveat of that file

client_site_share.source: scenario value: API traffic has no data-origin site; the repo gives no other value

chf_per_work_unit.source: derived: Public AI Apertus 8B CHF 0.084 in / 0.168 out per 1M tokens (docs/research/compute-demand-traces.md section 3, host location not stated) weighted by the Azure conv mean tokens per request, 1,632.7977 in / 105.6057 out (llm-token-quantiles.csv mean row): (0.084 x 1632.7977 + 0.168 x 105.6057) / 1e6 = CHF 1.5490e-4 per request / 1,738.4034 tokens = CHF 8.910e-8 per token
